summary: FULLY REFURBISHED ROOM TO RENT WITH OWN PRIVATE SHOWER ROOM My Property Box are pleased to bring to the market this newly refurbished, furnished single room in shared house which is located on the first floor and is decorated to a high standard, close to local amenities and Darlington Train Station. Property comprises of: Furnished single Bedroom, Shared Fully Fitted Kitchen/Dining Area, Private Shower Room. Early viewing is recommended, and is a short walk from the town centre, restaurants and bars. All Bills and Council Tax are included in the rent.
